messages:
alex: spotted a jump in WS reconnects at 03:12 UTC, partial frames then forced reconnects. billing shows suspicious duplicate resume charges.
sam: logs point to ping timeouts from edge-proxy; pings sent but no pongs before our 10s window, proxy force-closes.
lee: could be routing changes — some routes flipped to stateless regional policy yesterday.
irene: telemetry correlates reconnects with routes using sticky=false; suspect mid-flight proxy hops break KV cache continuity.
alex: proposal: edge-proxy emits `x-proxy-hop-count` when >1. gateway reads it and tags `proxy_hop_count` in metrics.
sam: then change resume: if hop_count>1, perform a quick cache probe `cache.peek(session_id)` with 5ms timeout; if probe fails, treat as fresh session. cheap and safer.
lee: add `resume_validation:{none,quick}` tag and `route_policy` label to reconnect dashboard so PMs can see impact.
ops-bot: alert: ws_reconnect_rate > 0.8% on /v1/streaming/chat-region-eu.
irene: timeline: I will build dashboard panel and ingestion mapping. sam, can you open proxy PR behind `feature.hop_count`?
sam: yes, PR shortly. will include e2e smoke test that injects an extra hop.
alex: ops will watch the canary and compare `resume_success_rate` split by hop_count. if dup charges persist, we will roll back.
lee: follow-up: add `resume_path` tag (`direct`,`proxied`) to billing traces so finance can filter duplicates.
irene: agreed. proceeding with canary plan and short observation window.
